title: Thermal Expansion for Ferrous Materials
notes: GENERAL NOTE: Coefficient A is the instantaneous coefficient of thermal expansion × 10−6 (mm/mm/°C). Coefficient B is the mean coeffi- cient of thermal expansion × 10−6 (mm/mm/°C) in going from 20°C to indicated temperature. Coefficient C is the linear thermal expansion (mm/m) in going from 20°C to indicated temperature.
